raw_extraction.description: Meta Ads provides a comprehensive Marketing API that supports ad creation, management, optimization, insights, audience management, and various ad formats across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and other Meta platforms.
raw_extraction.api_breadth: The API covers ad creation, campaign management, ad performance optimization, audience management, insights, various ad formats including video, carousel, lead ads, partnership ads, and advanced features like Advantage+ campaigns, Conversions API, and Catalog management.
raw_extraction.mcp_notes: Meta provides official developer centers and documentation for the Marketing API, including guides, references, and SDKs for integration.
raw_extraction.buildability_rationale: The official Meta Marketing API documentation provides detailed guides, references, and authentication methods (including OAuth2 and system user access tokens) enabling developers to build integrations for ad creation, management, and analytics.
